assertions: Lilly will purchase Master B.'s houses — the bargain will be perfected and the houses become his, not lost to another buyer

He will deal successfully with the seller: agreement is reached between the seller's side and the houses, shown by Venus near the 7th cusp in exaltation applying to a trine of Saturn, lord of the 4th (the houses)
His hopes in the matter will be fulfilled: the lord of the 7th being also lord of the 11th (his hopes) ties the seller directly to fulfilment of his hope of buying

The negotiation will involve difficulty and hard bargaining, not a smooth immediate agreement — the Moon translates light by a square — but the square out of signs of long ascension is mitigated and does not break the deal
His own money cannot be called in in time as things stand — Mercury, lord of his 2nd, retrograde shows his money delayed/unavailable for about six months, so paying is the hard part of the matter

Despite the money delay, he will procure money in time enough to complete the purchase (by waiting out / arranging payment terms or raising it by other means) rather than the purchase failing for want of money
The houses themselves are sound as a purchase: Saturn, lord of the 4th, has no material debility except retrogradation and cadency, so no hidden ruinous defect in the property defeats the bargain
method: Classical horary astrology after Lilly (Christian Astrology, Book II): significators 1st/2nd/4th/7th/11th, reception, application, translation of light
reasoning: Seller in 7th with Venus exalted near 7th cusp applying by trine to Saturn lord 4th perfects the matter between seller and houses; lord 7th = lord 11th links seller to querent's hopes. Moon translating light by square shows perfection through difficulty, mitigated because the square is out of signs of long ascension. Against ease of payment: Mercury lord 2nd retrograde = querent's money cannot be recalled in time (six months). Saturn lord 4th otherwise without material debility, only retrograde/cadent, shows delay/weakness of timing but no fatal defect in the houses. Hence purchase succeeds (positive) with money as the delayed, negotiated element.
summary: He shall buy the houses and the deal will be perfected, though raising the purchase money in time will be difficult and delayed.
